name: EPIC 210442867
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 16.0 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,127 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.97 solar masses and 16.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,463 K at its surface.
